chain_type.description: The chain type for proxy selection. Must be one of the uncommented directives: 'dynamic_chain', 'strict_chain', 'round_robin_chain', or 'random_chain'.

dns_method.description: The DNS proxying method. Must be one of the uncommented directives: 'proxy_dns', 'proxy_dns_old', or 'proxy_dns_daemon 127.0.0.1:1053'.

remote_dns_subnet.description: The class A subnet number for internal remote DNS mapping.

proxy_line.description: The proxy definition line in the [ProxyList] section, formatted as 'type ip port [user pass]'.
